title: From your Fizzl wallet to Claude Desktop: the whole install, step by step

card.title: From your Fizzl wallet to Claude.
card.sub: The whole install, step by step.
card.note: About two minutes · no keys to copy

segments.text: Here's how to give Claude Desktop its own wallet, from start to finish. It takes about two minutes, and you never copy a key.
Sign in at wallet.fizzl.eu and open the Agents tab. In the card that says: link an agent with a code, click: download the wallet.
Your browser downloads one file, fizzl-wallet.mcpb. Open it, and Claude Desktop takes it from there.
Claude Desktop shows the extension and the tools it brings. Click Install, and confirm. There's no config file to edit, and no Node.js to set up.
Start a new chat and ask: what is my wallet status? Claude asks once if it may use the wallet. Allow it. The wallet makes its own key on your computer, and answers with a link and a short code.
Click the link. Your wallet opens with the code already filled in, and shows which agent asks to be linked. Give it a name, and click: link this agent.
Now give it a few dollars to spend: send USDC on Base from the wallet in your browser, with one click. It doesn't need any ETH.
Click: test my setup. It checks the five things your agent needs, without paying anything. All green? You're ready.
Back in Claude, just ask. Claude finds a paid service, pays it within your limits, and answers. Anything above your limits waits for your OK on your phone.
And every purchase shows up in your wallet, with a receipt in plain words.

card.title: Ready in two minutes.
card.note: Never holds your keys or your money

segments.text: That's it. The Fizzl Agent Wallet: free to start, at wallet.fizzl.eu.
